headerDisplay: Exposes Eufy RoboVac robots as **native Matter Robotic Vacuum Cleaner** devices through Homebridge 2's Matter support. Requires Homebridge 2.0+ with Matter enabled on this (child) bridge, and a Matter controller (Apple Home needs iOS 18.4+).
footerDisplay: Two control backends: **Local** (older/legacy models, needs deviceId + localKey) and **Cloud** (newer 'novel' models like the L60, needs your eufy email + password). See the README.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Name shown for this platform in the Homebridge logs.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name for this robot (shown in your Matter/Home app).

backend.title: Control backend

oneOf.title: Auto (local if localKey set, else cloud)
Cloud (eufy account) - novel models e.g. L60

backend.description: How to control the robot. Novel models (L60 etc.) only work over Cloud.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: The robot's Tuya/eufy device ID (required for both backends).

localKey.title: Local Key (local backend)
localKey.description: The robot's Tuya local key. Required for the Local backend.

deviceIp.title: Device IP (local backend, optional)
deviceIp.description: Static IP of the robot. Optional, improves local performance.

protocolVersion.title: Tuya protocol version (local backend)
protocolVersion.description: Local Tuya LAN protocol version. If local connects but times out, try 3.4 then 3.5.

email.title: Eufy email (cloud backend)
email.description: Your eufy account email. Required for the Cloud backend.

password.title: Eufy password (cloud backend)
password.description: Your eufy account password. Required for the Cloud backend.

mop.title: Mop-capable model (cloud backend)
mop.description: Enable for Hybrid models (e.g. L60 Hybrid). Exposes Vacuum / Mop / Vacuum & Mop clean modes instead of suction levels. Note: Apple Home doesn't display clean modes, but other Matter controllers do.

placeholderRooms.title: Placeholder rooms (cloud backend)
placeholderRooms.description: Discovery helper: if no named rooms are listed below, generate this many placeholder rooms (Room 1..N, ids 1..N) so you can find which id maps to which real room, then replace them with named rooms.

rooms.title: Rooms (cloud backend)
rooms.description: Named rooms for Apple Home's Service Area (iOS 18.4+). The 'id' must match the robot's map room id. Use the placeholder rooms above to discover the ids first. When rooms are listed here, they take priority over placeholder rooms.

mapId.title: Map ID (cloud backend, optional)
mapId.description: The map the rooms belong to. Usually can be left blank.
